nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint256) balanceOf holding token balances.
Public string token name 'FRANCE_WINS'.
Public string token symbol 'FRAWII'.
Public uint8 decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 totalSupply = 87205228707660300000000000.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance.
Constructor-like public function that mints totalSupply to msg.sender.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value) moving balances from msg.sender.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value) setting allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) spending allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as owner key for balances and allowances.
Arithmetic state update balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value inside transfer.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, receiver address.
Parameter 'value' of transfer, amount to move.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, delegated address.
Parameter 'value' of approve, allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, source address.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, receiver address.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom, amount to move.
Arithmetic state update balanceOf[from] -= value inside transferFrom.
Return boolean 'success' declared by transfer/approve/transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the owner key to read/write balanceOf.
msg.sender is used as the owner key inside the allowance mapping.
Constructor assigns balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
totalSupply is written into balanceOf[msg.sender] during construction.
Constructor reads totalSupply to mint initial supply.
transfer reads and writes balanceOf entries.
transfer executes the balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value arithmetic update.
transfer uses the 'to' parameter as recipient key.
transfer uses the 'value' parameter as transfer amount.
value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
Unchecked subtraction writes resulting balance into balanceOf.
approve writes into the allowance mapping.
approve keys allowance with msg.sender as owner.
spender parameter is used as the inner allowance key.
value parameter is stored as the approved allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf entries.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom executes the balanceOf[from] -= value arithmetic update.
from parameter is the key of the subtracted balance.
value parameter is the amount subtracted from balanceOf[from].
allowance[from][msg.sender] is decremented by value.
Unchecked subtraction writes resulting balance into balanceOf[from].
to parameter is credited in balanceOf[to] += value.
msg.sender keys the allowance lookup inside transferFrom.
success local variable is returned by transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' exists only to key balanceOf inside transfer; it folds into the core transfer function.
Parameter 'value' directly feeds the balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value unsafe operation.
Parameter 'spender' is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter 'value' is only used to set the allowance inside approve.
Parameter 'from' directly keys the balanceOf[from] -= value unsafe operation.
Parameter 'to' is only used to credit balanceOf inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'value' directly feeds the balanceOf[from] -= value unsafe operation.
Local boolean 'success' is merely the return flag of the transfer function.
